boards.title: 01 发现与选择
boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-resolution presentation board showing FIVE distinct Nerae native mobile app screens in a single horizontal row, flat front views, identical slim black rounded device frames, full screens visible, no perspective, no hands. Landscape canvas approximately 3840 x 2160, crisp legible Chinese type, generous but efficient margin, five large evenly sized phones. At the top left: board title provided below; top right small "NERAE / APP PREVIEW". Under each phone: its short numbered step label. A delicate arrow between neighboring step labels makes reading order left to right clear. Bottom corner small "App 设计预览 · 人物与内容均为样例". This is a realistic, implementable high-fidelity product design, not abstract concept art.
STYLE CONSISTENCY: match the supplied Nerae mobile UI reference images. Porcelain #F3F4F1 page background, white #FFFFFF content panels, charcoal #252C29 feature surfaces, sage #E6EBDD feedback panels, warm coral #FF9A75 for one main action, readable dark text #252C29, muted #606A63. Modern Chinese PingFang-like type, large clear headings, carefully aligned details, rounded 14–20 px panels, subtle separators, fine 1.5 px line icons, editorial crop of natural gym / food photographs where useful. Typography hierarchy and useful content must feel rich and professional. Keep screen layouts native and mobile-specific. Use a standard quiet status bar and bottom home indicator. Main student tabs, when appropriate, are exactly "今天 / 发现 / 记录 / 消息"; deeper tasks use a back button, not a bottom tab bar.
REFERENCE ROLES: input images are style and product-reference images, not pixel-preservation edit targets. Produce new mobile screen designs for the specified flow. Follow the existing brand rather than inventing a new palette. Gym photography illustrates content; use initial "言" for coach 顾言, no invented coach portrait, credentials, star ratings, testimonials or before/after body results.
PRODUCT INVARIANTS: adult users only; free training and diet discovery; coach prices are independent service prices, not a Nerae membership. Platform has NO checkout, payment, QR code, external contact number or subscription purchase. Consultation alone does not create a service relationship or grant health access. Health collection consent is separate from sharing permission. Training recording has exactly two interchangeable modes "训练后记录" and "每组完成后记录", with the same underlying draft. No live-workout player, start/pause workout control, stopwatch, rest timer, countdown, invented elapsed time, calories burned or automatically inferred completed sets. Plain plan rest guidance or manually entered actual seconds is not a timer. AI provides drafts/suggestions for review and never automatically publishes or applies a plan.
Render the quoted short Chinese labels accurately. Use concise readable real UI copy; do not fill with lorem ipsum or dense illegible microtext. Every phone shows a coherent complete distinct task state and one clear primary action. Keep all controls inside safe areas. Use enough useful content to show the product's value without decorative charts or empty cards. 
NATIVE PRODUCT RULE: Never show the development "预览" button, debug controls, browser toolbar or a scrollbar inside the app. "APP PREVIEW" is allowed only outside the phones on the presentation board. Coach 江遥 monthly service is exactly "¥560 / 月"; 顾言 monthly service is "¥699 / 月". Never substitute one provider price for another.

BOARD TITLE: "01 发现与选择".
Phone 1, label "01 今天": Home. "林澈，今天练得如何？". Charcoal split photograph training feature "上肢力量", "5 个动作 · 14 组安排", coral "记录训练". Below a sage coach follow-up with initial 言, "顾言 · 你的教练", short specific sample feedback "先把动作做稳，再慢慢加重量", "查看点评". A compact row for next plan and real recorded history. Bottom student tabs.
Phone 2, label "02 免费内容": Discover tab. Title "找到适合自己的练法". Tabs "训练 / 饮食 / 教练" with 训练 active, search field. A large editorial gym photograph with title "上肢拉力与划船", "5 个动作 · 每周 2 次", "免费". Two smaller content cards with distinct images: "核心稳定" and "训练后舒展". No invented huge catalogue count. Bottom tabs.
Phone 3, label "03 完整计划": Back arrow, "上肢拉力与划船". Small illustrative band training photo, readable "5 个动作 · 12 组". Full visible action list: "高位下拉 3×12", "坐姿划船 3×12", "面拉 2×15", "哑铃弯举 2×12", "平板支撑 2×40秒". Clear conditions "需要器械 · 按自身情况选择". Sticky coral button "用这份计划记录", secondary 收藏 icon. No workout start button.
Phone 4, label "04 选择教练": Discover coach tab active. "找到愿意一起投入的教练". A rich coach service card with dumbbells illustration photo, initial 言, "顾言", "力量基础 · 月度计划", exact "¥699 / 月", includes "每周 3 次训练安排", "训练后文字反馈", "每 4 周调整计划". Smaller second provider card "江遥 · 耐力与体能". No unverified rating.
Phone 5, label "05 查看交付": Coach service detail "顾言", "力量基础与动作调整". Charcoal header and dumbbell content photo. Sage numbered deliverables with the same three monthly items, exact monthly quote "¥699 / 月", visible alternative "动作调整 · 单次 ¥199 / 次" as a separate package, sample entry "查看完整训练日样例". Coral button "预约咨询". Small qualification line "资质尚未核验". Do not bury the delivery and price behind a huge photograph.

BOARD TITLE: "02 咨询、确认与接收计划".
Phone 1, label "06 站内咨询": Native chat with coach 顾言, package context strip "力量基础 · 月度计划 ¥699 / 月". This is agreement confirmation, absolutely no purchase / pay button or payment status.
Phone 3, label "08 单独授权": A separate relation permission screen after collection consent. Title "允许顾言查看哪些内容？". Explain "仅用于当前服务，可随时撤回". Three individually selectable, initially unchecked permissions for "训练记录", "饮食自评", "身体数据". No blanket prechecked consent. Primary "确认所选授权", secondary "暂不授权". A compact link "健康信息采集说明" remains separate.
Phone 4, label "09 查看新计划": Incoming delivered plan "顾言发来新的计划". Version pill "版本 7". A concise comparison "每周 3 次安排", "调整 2 个动作", "新增动作说明". Show "仅影响未来安排，历史记录保留" and option to review full plan. Primary "采用新版计划", secondary "暂时保留原版". No automatic enablement, no fake benefit claim.
Phone 5, label "10 我的安排": My plan "力量基础 · 第 4 周". A seven-day strip and 3 readable schedule rows for 周二 / 周四 / 周六, distinct training content and 休息日. Small source "来自顾言 · 版本 7". A separate diet entry. Next-step coral button "记录这次训练". No countdown or calculated workout completion time.
At the board footer include one short annotation outside phones: "服务流程以允许渠道核定及双方确认约定为前提". Do not suggest the current channel gate has already passed.

BOARD TITLE: "03 记录训练与回看反馈".
Phone 1, label "11 训练后记录": Record editor for "上肢力量", editable training date. Two-mode segmented control, selected "训练后记录", other "每组完成后记录". Phone 5, label "15 教练点评": Detail of one recorded training, date, exercise/set rows, then sage feedback block with initial 言 and 顾言, exact concise comment "卧推最后一组更稳了。先保持 12.5 kg，把次数补齐。". Source link "对应这次训练". CTA "就这次记录问教练", normal text composer below. Feedback is tied to one record and no medical or guaranteed outcome claim.

BOARD TITLE: "04 饮食自评与 AI 辅助".

BOARD TITLE: "05 教练交付闭环".

Phone 1, label "21 处理待办": Coach home "顾言，先处理这些事". A strong top item "林澈 · 训练记录待点评", another "计划草稿 · 等待审阅", then "新咨询 · 待回复". Each has reason and clear next action. Small counts only, no revenue, no invented huge business metrics. Primary "继续上次草稿".

boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-resolution presentation board showing FIVE distinct Nerae native mobile app screens in a single horizontal row, flat front views, identical slim black rounded device frames, full screens visible, no perspective, no hands. Landscape canvas approximately 3840 x 2160, crisp legible Chinese type, generous but efficient margin, five large evenly sized phones. At the top left: board title provided below; top right small "NERAE / APP PREVIEW". Under each phone: its short numbered step label. A delicate arrow between neighboring step labels makes reading order left to right clear. Bottom corner small "App 设计预览 · 人物与内容均为样例". This is a realistic, implementable high-fidelity product design, not abstract concept art.
STYLE CONSISTENCY: match the supplied Nerae mobile UI reference images. Porcelain #F3F4F1 page background, white #FFFFFF content panels, charcoal #252C29 feature surfaces, sage #E6EBDD feedback panels, warm coral #FF9A75 for one main action, readable dark text #252C29, muted #606A63. Modern Chinese PingFang-like type, large clear headings, carefully aligned details, rounded 14–20 px panels, subtle separators, fine 1.5 px line icons, editorial crop of natural gym / food photographs where useful. Typography hierarchy and useful content must feel rich and professional. Keep screen layouts native and mobile-specific. Use a standard quiet status bar and bottom home indicator. Main student tabs, when appropriate, are exactly "今天 / 发现 / 记录 / 消息"; deeper tasks use a back button, not a bottom tab bar.
REFERENCE ROLES: input images are style and product-reference images, not pixel-preservation edit targets. Produce new mobile screen designs for the specified flow. Follow the existing brand rather than inventing a new palette. Gym photography illustrates content; use initial "言" for coach 顾言, no invented coach portrait, credentials, star ratings, testimonials or before/after body results.
PRODUCT INVARIANTS: adult users only; free training and diet discovery; coach prices are independent service prices, not a Nerae membership. Platform has NO checkout, payment, QR code, external contact number or subscription purchase. Consultation alone does not create a service relationship or grant health access. Health collection consent is separate from sharing permission. Training recording has exactly two interchangeable modes "训练后记录" and "每组完成后记录", with the same underlying draft. No live-workout player, start/pause workout control, stopwatch, rest timer, countdown, invented elapsed time, calories burned or automatically inferred completed sets. Plain plan rest guidance or manually entered actual seconds is not a timer. AI provides drafts/suggestions for review and never automatically publishes or applies a plan.
Render the quoted short Chinese labels accurately. Use concise readable real UI copy; do not fill with lorem ipsum or dense illegible microtext. Every phone shows a coherent complete distinct task state and one clear primary action. Keep all controls inside safe areas. Use enough useful content to show the product's value without decorative charts or empty cards. 
NATIVE PRODUCT RULE: Never show the development "预览" button, debug controls, browser toolbar or a scrollbar inside the app. "APP PREVIEW" is allowed only outside the phones on the presentation board. Coach 江遥 monthly service is exactly "¥560 / 月"; 顾言 monthly service is "¥699 / 月". Never substitute one provider price for another.

BOARD TITLE: "06 首次进入、授权与恢复".
This board shows important ALTERNATIVE / recovery states, not one forced onboarding funnel. Under title a short subtitle "按需出现，不阻挡免费浏览".
Phone 1, label "26 按需登录": Clean native bottom-sheet sign-in over a dimmed FREE plan browse screen. Title "保存记录前，先登录". Simple 手机号 field and 验证码 field, concise unchecked age checkbox "我已年满 18 周岁" and separate agreement checkbox. Primary "登录并继续", secondary "先继续浏览". No mandatory long health-profile setup; no actual personal phone number rendered.
Phone 2, label "27 采集同意": A separate clear HEALTH COLLECTION CONSENT screen before collecting optional health information. Title "健康信息，由你决定". Brief purposes and chosen data categories, link "查看完整说明". Two distinct actions "同意并继续" / "暂不填写". Explicit "不会自动向教练共享"; no combined relation-sharing permission and no prechecked consent.
Phone 3, label "28 管理共享": Privacy / current relation permission management. "与顾言共享的内容", grouped scopes 训练记录/饮食自评/身体数据, visible explicit granted vs not granted states. "撤回后，停止后续访问". Button "管理授权" and reversible-looking dialog preview "确认撤回训练记录授权？" with "暂不撤回" and "确认撤回"; not a deletion or account purge. Do not imply historical human memory erased.
Phone 4, label "29 保存失败恢复": Training record editor showing still-filled sample weight/reps. A warm muted error banner "这次还没有保存成功", explanatory "填写内容仍在，稍后可以重试". Main "重试保存", secondary "保留草稿返回". No saved-success check, fake server sync success, or discarded inputs. No timer.
Phone 5, label "30 第一次记录": Empty records screen matching style and purposeful hierarchy. "你的训练积累，从这一条开始". No invented graph or progress stats. One compact icon/illustration, brief "保存实际完成的动作和组，会显示在这里". Primary "记录一次训练", secondary "先找一份免费计划". Bottom tabs. Empty state feels intentional, not thin or broken.
